topics.title: WRITING WITH IMPACT
topics.body:
WRITING WITH IMPACT

WRITING WITH IMPACT puts STANLEY's longform geometry through the print head from IMPACT PRINTER and SUDDEN IMPACT. It is a SMACKTALK skin for photographs and serious writing presented as continuous tractor-feed output: perforated paper, dot-matrix type and unapologetically mechanical image frames.

Best Fit

Use it when the post is the destination. It supports longform posts and comments, but deliberately omits the calendar tray, masonry view and carousel.

topics.title: Paper, Type and Ink
topics.body:
Paper, Type and Ink

  • Paper Stock — choose plain continuous paper or green-bar ledger paper in Smooth Your Skin.
  • Ribbon Ink — changes the printed text, links and rules.
  • Header and Body Type — choose from the Tiny5 and complete DotMatrix family shared with IMPACT PRINTER and SUDDEN IMPACT.
  • Optional Masthead — upload a header image or logo, or leave both blank for the pure dot-matrix nameplate.

topics.title: Frames, Layout and Archive
topics.body:
Frames, Layout and Archive

Image borders can be printed as ASCII box, plus, equals or slash treatments, with separate controls for border weight and padding. Choose Raw Print to remove the frame.

The optional sidebar and reading-width control follow STANLEY's geometry. The archive uses each post's featured image and links to the post. Square and cropped thumbnails are available; cropped images are constrained between 2:3 and 3:2. On tablets and phones the paper and columns collapse without requiring a separate mobile skin.
